sql: SELECT c.date AS ds, SUM(s.sales) AS y FROM m5_sales_train s JOIN m5_calendar c ON s.d = c.d WHERE s.item_id = 'FOODS_3_576' AND s.state_id = 'TX' GROUP BY c.date ORDER BY c.date ASC
sql_explanation: Retrieves the daily sales trend (y) for product FOODS_3_576 in state TX (filters) using the M5 dataset. The query joins the sales data with the calendar to use the real date (c.date) as the time index (ds).
